scripts.docker:up: sh scripts/compose-stack.sh local up -d postgres redis
scripts.db:test:schema:push:local: DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade?schema=test' pnpm exec prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:test:prepare:open-dispute-guard:local: DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade?schema=test' pnpm exec prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/pre_migrations/20260409_dispute_open_unique_guard.sql
scripts.docker:test:db: pnpm docker:up && pnpm db:test:schema:push:local && pnpm db:test:prepare:open-dispute-guard:local && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade TEST_DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade?schema=test' ENABLE_PERSISTENCE=true ENABLE_REDIS_RATE_LIMIT=false pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:db
scripts.docker:test:stress: pnpm docker:up && pnpm db:test:schema:push:local && pnpm db:test:prepare:open-dispute-guard:local && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade TEST_DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade?schema=test' ENABLE_PERSISTENCE=true ENABLE_REDIS_RATE_LIMIT=false pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:stress
scripts.docker:test:cli:persistence: pnpm docker:up && pnpm db:test:schema:push:local && pnpm db:test:prepare:open-dispute-guard:local && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade TEST_DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade?schema=test' ENABLE_PERSISTENCE=true ENABLE_REDIS_RATE_LIMIT=false pnpm --filter @agentrade/cli test:persistence:strict
scripts.docker:test:full: pnpm docker:test:db && pnpm docker:test:stress && pnpm docker:test:cli:persistence
scripts.db:prepare:legacy-disputes: pnpm exec prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/pre_migrations/20260408_dispute_status_backfill.sql
scripts.db:prepare:open-dispute-guard: pnpm exec prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/pre_migrations/20260409_dispute_open_unique_guard.sql
scripts.check:fast: pnpm toolchain:check && pnpm -r lint && pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:non-db && pnpm --filter @agentrade/web test:unit && pnpm --filter @agentrade/cli test
scripts.check:db:strict: REQUIRE_TEST_DATABASE_URL=true pnpm toolchain:check && REQUIRE_TEST_DATABASE_URL=true pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:db && REQUIRE_TEST_DATABASE_URL=true pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:stress && pnpm --filter @agentrade/cli test:persistence:strict
